decision: Which topics are people already finding us for where better content would win more clicks?
limitations: It sees only queries where your pages appeared. It cannot size a market or show demand you never appeared for, and impressions are not search volume.
Topics group queries by their most common word. This is coarse on purpose; read the top queries under a topic before acting on it.
Branded share depends on the brand words you list. Leave one out and branded searches are counted as non-branded demand.
Cannibalisation needs the page for each query; without it none can be found. The 200-impression, position-10 and 20%-split cut-offs are this engine's rules.
review: The content or SEO lead checks the export covers at least three months and includes pages, confirms the brand and rival words, and reads each gap's top queries before briefing a page.
